messages.subject: Re: IBM Watson Free Tier with R
messages.subject_clean: IBM Watson Free Tier with R
messages.body_plain:
Cocalc is the bomb, been paying $79 for three years now. Highly recommended to try and subscribe.

On Monday, November 19, 2018 at 3:34:34 PM UTC-9, Evelyn Mitchell wrote:
> For R in the cloud, I've been happy with cocalc.com <http://cocalc.com>
> The free version is quite resource restricted, but there's a huge number of packages and
> associated math programs installed, and the $80 year version has been just what I needed.
>
> https://colab.research.google.com is python2/3 but I suspect they may add R eventually.
> Notable for being backed by GPUs and their generous free level, which is lovely if
> you're doing tensorflow.
>
> Evelyn Mitchell
>
> On Sunday, November 18, 2018 at 3:05:30 AM UTC-7, Rich Gillin wrote:
> > LittleMissData Blog Post <https://www.littlemissdata.com/blog/watsonstudio>
> >
> > Tons of R goodness in the cloud by LittleMissData. I have not gone down this route yet may do over the holidays..
> >
> > So, I want to encourage all in the group to increase engagement with comments, reviews, new topics for discussion and just a place to geek out on #RStats.
> >
> > Google Groups is hitting well on a few of my requirements and want to see how it takes post AUG2019.
> >
> > "Push Through" ~Hadley Wickham
> >
> > "Engage"! ~J.L. Picard
